# Wings - full agent context

> Nested pages with LaTeX, Excalidraw, on-device lecture transcription, a local vault folder, and BYOK AI. Private journal product on https://wings.nopejs.me

## Summary

Wings is a Vite SPA journal. Marketing pages and the blog are public. The app (`/app`, `/:username`), auth, checkout, and share links (`/s/`) are private or noindex. People sign in with Supabase (Google or magic link PKCE). A signed-in user can mint a personal access token or approve an OAuth client for their own pages. Remote MCP is `POST https://wings.nopejs.me/api/mcp` with `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. The API does not return another user's notes. Local vault bodies stay on a connected folder; the API returns the title and says the body is not on the server. AI in the editor is still bring-your-own-key in the browser.

## Crawler policy

robots.txt declares Content-Signal: ai-train=no, search=yes, ai-input=yes. Training bots (GPTBot, Google-Extended, Applebot-Extended, ClaudeBot, CCBot, Bytespider) are Disallow. Search and citation bots remain allowed. User content routes stay Disallow.
